description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy, in percentage values, of a model across several conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Ours w/c”, “w/o text”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, and “w/o cognition” for the first set of bars, and “Ours”, “w/o comments”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, and “w/o cognition” for the second set, listed in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and presents a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks at 2.5-unit intervals. The first set of bars is colored in shades of red, ranging from a height of approximately 80.10 for “w/o text” to 86.82 for “Ours w/c”. The second set of bars is colored in shades of blue, ranging from a height of approximately 83.02 for “w/o comments” to 90.57 for “Ours”. Each bar represents a single data point, and there are no visible groupings or stacking within the bars. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
